extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians preparing manuscripts/references, journal editors, and typesetters
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on the correct form of the title and abbreviation to use when citing Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik (Crelle's Journal), and on avoiding an Americanized abbreviation introduced by Math Reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official journal name
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the journal's official name as given on the journal website: 'Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The author cites the journal website (http://www.degruyter.com/view/j/crll) as the source for the official name. Prefer the journal's own stated title when citing it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preferred (historical) abbreviation
rubrics_metrics.description: For many years, Math Reviews abbreviated the Journal’s name as 'J. reine angew. Math.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This lowercased form reflects the traditional abbreviation and is the form the note's author used ('J. reine angew. Math.'). Consider using this established abbreviation rather than later Americanized variants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Math Reviews' Americanized abbreviation
rubrics_metrics.description: Math Reviews now cites the journal as 'J. Reine Angew. Math.' — an Americanized capitalization of the older abbreviation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The author considers this change an unnecessary americanization and advises against adopting it. Do not blindly follow Math Reviews' capitalization/americanization when it alters the original/established form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preserve original language features (capitalization/diacritics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain the original German capitalization and diacritics of the journal title/abbreviation (e.g., 'für', umlaut in 'für'; the historically lowercased 'reine angew.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The note's complaint highlights that changing 'J. reine angew. Math.' to 'J. Reine Angew. Math.' modifies original orthography; authors/editors should preserve the original orthographic features where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check and correct typesetter/editor changes in proofs
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors should review galley proofs and correct any unwanted changes to references introduced by typesetters or editors (such as forced adoption of Math Reviews' abbreviation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The author reports receiving galley proofs in which their references were changed twice in two years. Practical advice: inspect proofs carefully and revert unwanted stylistic changes to references to maintain the correct journal form.
